comment:
Quote: "There were several selection effects between WLH in the EI and
the SC who were successfully re-assessed and those who were lost
to follow up. Within the SC condition, re-assessed WLH were
more likely to be married or living with their partner, employed,
and have water on site and a flush toilet. Compared to EI mothers
lost to follow-up, re-assessed EI mothers were older and less likely
to have a chronic illness. There were no serious study-related
adverse events."; Quote: "In many interventions,
those most in need of intervention are most likely to attend [31],
but this is less possible in rural southern Africa."
